title: Py4JJavaError: java.lang.ClassNotFoundException: com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.spark
question:
I'm trying to connect pyspark to SQLServer v.16 (reading a table). My spark and pyspark versions are same, I've also downloaded spark mssql server connector (spark-mssql-connector_2.11_2.4-1.0.2.jar) but I don't know what's the right place to store the connector.jar file. It's giving me error com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.spark not found.

from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
spark = SparkSession\
.builder\
.master('local[*]')\
.appName('Connection-Test')\
.config('spark.executor.extraclasspath', 'C:/Spark/spark-3.4.0-bin- hadoop3/com/microsoft/sqlserver/jdbc/spark/spark-mssql-connector_2.11_2.4-1.0.2.jar')\
.getOrCreate()
sqlsUrl = 'jdbc:sqlserver://Server_IP:1433;database=Master'
print("code is here 2")
qryStr = """ (
SELECT *
FROM dbo.table1
) t """
print("code is here 3")
spark.read.format('jdbc')\
.option('url',sqlsUrl)\
.option('driver', 'com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc.spark')\
.option('dbtable', qryStr )\
.option("user", "user_name") \
.option("password", "password") \
.load().show()

Apache Spark Engine 3.4.0 ,pypsark 3.4.0, Python 3.11 and then downloaded the jar file spark mssql server connector and pasted in my Spark directory. I'm looking to extract the data or reading the data from SQL server and then want to upload it to Share point location.
answer:
Please try the below steps:

To fix this issue, we need to download the appropriate jar file from Microsoft. For SQL Server 2017, we can download it from : https://mvnrepository.com/artifact/com.microsoft.sqlserver/sqljdbc42/6.0.8112

  1. Download the driver file.

  2. unzip it and get the “sqljdbc42.jar” file from “sqljdbc_6.0\enu\jre8” location (if are using java 8).

  3. Copy it to spark’s jar folder. In our case it is C:\Spark\spark-2.4.3-bin-hadoop2.7\jars.

  4. Start a new SparkSession if required.

Note: make sure you stop the existing spark session and start a new spark session before running the code.

for more details refer this thread: https://sqlrelease.com/read-and-write-data-to-sql-server-from-spark-using-pyspark
